text: CloudWay 24 offers a simple and flexible process for changing your seat to suit your comfort and preference. Whether you want extra legroom, prefer a window or aisle seat, or wish to sit closer to the front, you can manage your seat selection seamlessly through our website or mobile app.

- Visit CloudWay24.com (https://cloudway24.com) or open the CloudWay24 App (iOS & Android).
- Log in using your registered email or mobile number.
path: Change Your Seat with CloudWay 24 > How to Change Your Seat > 1. Log in to Your Account

text:
- Select Manage My Flight from the main menu/dashboard.
- Enter your booking reference (PNR) and last name to access your reservation.
path: Change Your Seat with CloudWay 24 > How to Change Your Seat > 2. Navigate to “Manage My Flight”

text:
- Find your upcoming journey from the list.
- Click on Change your seat under your flight details.
path: Change Your Seat with CloudWay 24 > How to Change Your Seat > 3. Select “Change Your Seat” Option

text:
- View the interactive seat map for your selected flight.
- Choose your new seat based on availability and cabin class:
  - CloudLux (First Class)
  - CloudElite (Business Class)
  - CloudComfort (Premium Economy)
  - CloudSaver (Economy)
- Note: Some seats (such as extra legroom or preferred locations) may carry an additional charge.
path: Change Your Seat with CloudWay 24 > How to Change Your Seat > 4. Choose Your Preferred Seat

text:
- Review any price difference, if applicable.
- Confirm your new seat selection.
- Receive instant confirmation and updated boarding pass.
path: Change Your Seat with CloudWay 24 > How to Change Your Seat > 5. Review & Confirm

text:
- Credit Card
- Debit Card
- Netbanking
- SkyPoints 24 Points (loyalty rewards)
path: Change Your Seat with CloudWay 24 > Payment Options

text:
- You can change your seat up until online check-in closes (generally 1 hour before departure).
- Seat changes are subject to availability.
- Loyalty members may have complimentary or discounted seat change options depending on SkyPoints 24 tier status.
path: Change Your Seat with CloudWay 24 > Useful Information

text: If you have any trouble changing your seat, contact our 24/7 Customer Support via live chat, email, or phone through the CloudWay 24 app or website.
path: Change Your Seat with CloudWay 24 > Need Help?

text: Fly your way—choose your preferred seat with CloudWay 24 for a journey tailored to you!
path: Change Your Seat with CloudWay 24 > Need Help?
